reviews.title: The GLP-1 Tracking App I Wish I’d Had From Day One
reviews.text:
I’ve been on tirzepatide for about nine months and only discovered Glapp a month ago. I genuinely wish I’d had it from the beginning of my journey. I’ve tried another GLP-1 tracking app, but within a day of finding Glap, I switched and haven’t looked back.

There is so much I love about this app. It estimates how much medication is in my system, which is especially helpful now that I’m split dosing; provides genuinely useful weekly reports; tracks my mood, energy, sleep, symptoms, and injection sites; reminds me where I last injected and helps me rotate locations; and gives me clear visuals that help me understand where I am in my medication cycle and what I may be experiencing. I also really appreciate that the information and answers provided in the app are grounded in science and the evidence base.

It manages to offer a wealth of information without making tracking feel burdensome. I’m only a month in and I’m sure I haven’t even discovered everything it can do yet. For anyone using a GLP-1 medication who wants to better understand and track their journey, I highly recommend Glapp. Kudos to this small team for creating such a thoughtful and genuinely useful app. I hope many more people discover it.

reviews.title: My all-in-one tracking app!
reviews.text: I was honestly resistant to using Glapp in the beginning, but the app has absolutely won me over! Being on a GLP-1 and a data girlie, the Glapp app is a dream. Weekly reports of my progress, tracking logs of shots, weight (also compared to peers on the medication!) are so handy. Glapp surged to the front of the line for me with their “supply” tracking. Prior to this, my supply tracking was manually adding mgs from looking at the vials in the fridge. Now, I can quickly check the app to have a clear picture of my supply health. Today, I expressed my one desire was to be able to customize the shot colors on the graph (minor detail, but was literally the only thing tying me to an old app - I love aesthetically pleasing colors) and the developer responded to let me know this IS indeed a capability, with instruction for how to accomplish. This app is great already, but knowing that the developer is always looking for ways to improve and truly listening to their target audience is such a rare but appreciated aspect.

reviews.title: Not ok with the forced update splash
reviews.text:
This app has been great up until today. When I opened it, I was hit with a splash screen that completely locked me out unless I updated the app. That felt totally unnecessary.

Feel free to suggest an update when one’s available, but randomly locking users out just to force an update to the latest version is not the way to do it. Barring that, this is a 5 star app. For now, it’s a 1.

**UPDATE**— given the response from the dev, changing my review to 5. Thank you for listing to your users!

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text:
I been using this program since before it was an app and since I started the medication. It has everything that I want to track and know, and more. It tracks everything my provider and dietician calculate and track but this way it’s all at my fingertips and I don’t have to calculate anything . I love the comparison between the trial data and other users. The tips and reports are right on target. Anytime I worry it’s not working I can look at the comparison data and see I’m right on target (vs just my provider telling me).
I love the layout and uncluttered pages and color schemes too. Being very visual that is important to me. I sit in front of a screen all day, so always in a hurry. I sync everything to make sure I track everything I need to. It linked flawlessly with my Apple health that is synced with my scale and a hub for my health. I hope the app can continue to be free so everyone has access to this in depth information and instead of charging possibly adding a feature often referred to as”buy a cup of coffee for developer”.
